turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: My energy is better and my cycles feel regular again.

turns.speaker: Dr Elara Vale
turns.text: The December blood test shows hemoglobin 131 and ferritin 48. Today is the last planned iron dose.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Are there still three embryos stored?

turns.speaker: Dr Elara Vale
turns.text: The fertility records show three remaining after the single transfer. No later transfer is in this record.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: We are not planning another pregnancy now.
